threads.body: [General] Removing `server.port` from the experimental-attributes inventory makes it incomplete: `ElasticsearchTransportInstrumenterFactory` installs the same database extractor in both modes, so non-default transport ports still emit this attribute with the flag enabled. The same issue affects the Elasticsearch Transport 5.3 entry near line 9419. Exercise a non-default transport port during metadata collection for both variants and regenerate the catalog so `server.port` remains documented in both modes.
threads.hunk:

         type: LONG
       - name: server.address
         type: STRING
+      - name: server.port
